1: // Nebula Runner - simple top‑down endless runner
2: // Canvas with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   // Audio setup
7:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
8:   const bgMusic = new Audio('bgm.mp3');
9:   bgMusic.loop = true;
10:   bgMusic.volume = 0.2;
11:   let audioStarted = false;
12:   const initAudio = () => {
13:     if (audioStarted) return;
14:     audioStarted = true;
15:     // Resume AudioContext after user interaction
16:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
17:     bgMusic.play().catch(() => {});
18:   };
19:   const beep = (freq = 440, dur = 0.2) => {
20:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
21:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
22:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
23:     gain.gain.value = 0.1;
24:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
25:     osc.start();
26:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
27:   };
28:   if (!canvas) {
29:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
30:     return;
31:   }
32:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
33: 
34:   // Set canvas size to fill the window (you can adjust as needed)
35:   const resize = () => {
36:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
37:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
38:   };
39:   resize();
40:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
41: 
42:   // Starfield – small white points moving down for a nebula effect
43:   const stars = [];
44:   const starCount = 100;
45:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
46:     stars.push({
47:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
48:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
49:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
50:       speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5,
51:     });
52:   }
53:   const updateStars = () => {
54:     for (const s of stars) {
55:       s.y += s.speed;
56:       if (s.y > canvas.height) {
57:         s.y = 0;
58:         s.x = Math.random() * canvas.width;
59:       }
60:     }
61:   };
62:   const drawStars = () => {
63:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
64:     for (const s of stars) {
65:       ctx.beginPath();
66:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
67:       ctx.fill();
68:     }
69:   };
70: 
71:   // Ship definition – gradient triangle at the bottom centre
72:   const ship = {
73:     width: 30,
74:     height: 40,
75:     x: canvas.width / 2,
76:     y: canvas.height - 60,
77:     speed: 5,
78:     movingLeft: false,
79:     movingRight: false,
80:     draw() {
81:       const shipGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, ship.y, 0, ship.y + ship.height);
82:     shipGradient.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
83:     shipGradient.addColorStop(1, '#005');
84:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGradient;
85:       ctx.beginPath();
86:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y);
87:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.width / 2, this.y + this.height);
88:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.width / 2, this.y + this.height);
89:       ctx.closePath();
90:       ctx.fill();
91:     }
92:   };
93: 
94:   // Input handling – arrow keys (or A/D)
95:   const keyDown = (e) => {
96:     initAudio();
97:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') ship.movingLeft = true;
98:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') ship.movingRight = true;
99:   };
100:   const keyUp = (e) => {
101:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') ship.movingLeft = false;
102:     if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd' || e.key === 'D') ship.movingRight = false;
103:   };
104:   window.addEventListener('keydown', keyDown);
105:   window.addEventListener('keyup', keyUp);
106: 
107:   // Asteroid definition – simple circles falling down
108:   const asteroids = [];
109:   const asteroidSpawnRate = 90; // frames between spawns
110:   let frameCount = 0;
111: 
112:   const spawnAsteroid = () => {
113:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 10;
114:     const x = radius + Math.random() * (canvas.width - 2 * radius);
115:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3;
116:     asteroids.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed });
117:   };
118: 
119:   const updateShip = () => {
120:     if (ship.movingLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
121:     if (ship.movingRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
122:     // Keep ship within bounds
123:     ship.x = Math.max(ship.width / 2, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width / 2, ship.x));
124:   };
125: 
126:   const updateAsteroids = () => {
127:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
128:       const a = asteroids[i];
129:       a.y += a.speed;
130:       if (a.y - a.radius > canvas.height) {
131:         asteroids.splice(i, 1); // remove off‑screen
132:       }
133:     }
134:     if (frameCount % asteroidSpawnRate === 0) spawnAsteroid();
135:   };
136: 
137:   const checkCollisions = () => {
138:     for (const a of asteroids) {
139:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
140:       const dy = a.y - (ship.y + ship.height / 2);
141:       const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
142:       // Approximate ship as circle of radius ship.width/2
143:       if (distance < a.radius + ship.width / 2) {
144:         return true;
145:       }
146:     }
147:     return false;
148:   };
149: 
150:   let score = 0;
151:   let gameOver = false;
152: 
153:   const drawScore = () => {
154:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
155:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
156:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 20, 30);
157:   };
158: 
159:   const drawGameOver = () => {
160:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
161:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
162:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
163:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
164:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
165:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
166:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
167:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
168:     ctx.fillText(`Final Score: ${score}`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 40);
169:   };
170: 
171:   const loop = () => {
172:     if (gameOver) {
173:       drawGameOver();
174:       return;
175:     }
176:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
177:     // Draw nebula background gradient
178:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
179:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#000014');
180:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000022');
181:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
182:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
183:     // Update entities
184:     updateShip();
185:     updateAsteroids();
186:     updateStars();
187:     // Draw background stars
188:     drawStars();
189:     // Draw entities
190:     ship.draw();
191:     // Draw asteroids with subtle gradient
192:     for (const a of asteroids) {
193:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, 0, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
194:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ccc');
195:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#444');
196:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
197:       ctx.beginPath();
198:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
199:       ctx.fill();
200:     }
201:     // Score based on time survived
202:     if (frameCount % 60 === 0) {
203:       score++;
204:       beep(800, 0.05); // subtle score tick
205:     }
206:     drawScore();
207:     // Collision check
208:     if (checkCollisions()) {
209:       beep(200, 0.3); // collision sound
210:       gameOver = true;
211:     }
212:     frameCount++;
213:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
214:   };
215: 
216:   // Start the game loop
217:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
218: })();
